title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Program Tiers: Entry Standards, Credit Lines and Signer Limits
content:
# Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease — Program Tier Schedule: Entry Standards, Credit Lines and Signer Limits

Every master lease agreement under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease sits in one of six program tiers. The figures below are the tier's own figures for entry, credit and order size; each row applies only to the tier named at its head.

## Entry standards

A tier's band is read against the business's active units, which are counted as in-service fleet units plus open business retail and balloon contracts.

| Program tier | Fewest active units | Most active units | Minimum years in business | Minimum Kestrel commercial credit score (1-100) at the last annual review | Principal's personal guaranty required on the master lease |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 1 | 4 | 2 | 60 | Yes |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 5 | 14 | 2 | 62 | Yes |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 15 | 49 | 3 | 65 | No |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 50 | 149 | 3 | 68 | No |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 150 | 499 | 5 | 70 | No |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 500 | 5000 | 5 | 72 | No |

The annual credit review of every master agreement takes place in month 3 of the year (March), in every tier.

## Credit line, order size and signers

The credit line is the maximum combined capitalized cost of in-service fleet units plus business retail and balloon principal. The overage tolerance is the percent above the credit line allowed for one in-transit order.

| Program tier | Credit line limit (USD) | Overage tolerance for one in-transit order | Most units in one order request | Most authorized signers on the master agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 250000 | 0 percent | 4 | 2 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 1000000 | 0 percent | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 3500000 | 5 percent | 25 | 4 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 10000000 | 5 percent | 50 | 6 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 30000000 | 10 percent | 100 | 8 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 90000000 | 10 percent | 250 | 10 |

## Reading the schedule

- **What counts toward the unit band?** In-service fleet units plus open business retail and balloon contracts, in every tier.
- **Which tiers allow any tolerance above the credit line?** Kestrel Fleet Preferred and Kestrel Fleet Premier allow 5 percent and Kestrel Fleet Enterprise and Kestrel National Fleet allow 10 percent, each for one order whose units are in transit; Kestrel Business Advantage and Kestrel Fleet Select allow none.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** For a business placed in Kestrel Fleet Preferred, a single in-transit order may take combined exposure up to the credit line of 3500000 increased by 5 percent of it, that is 3675000; a business in Kestrel Fleet Select has no such allowance above its 1000000 line.
